sourceTruth: Session recording identity, artists, year, categories and known duration must match the canonical continuous-set record. Editorial intent labels are hypotheses, not measured music attributes.
principles: Offer a small number of human-curated intents instead of generating playlists.
Use one verified continuous recording per suggestion.
Keep the canonical set identity intact and never derive synthetic chapter boundaries.
Show duration bands only when durationSeconds is known in source data.
Treat energy or mood words such as gentle and festive as editorial judgement requiring cultural review.
Do not claim BPM, popularity, gapless playback or ad-free playback without evidence.
Preserve direct Search and Nonstop browsing as first-class alternatives.

sessions.label: Gentle start
sessions.title: Nortani Raat | Nonstop Garba
sessions.rationale: A shorter known-duration candidate within this four-session prototype. The word ‘gentle’ is an editorial hypothesis for usability testing, not a BPM or measured-energy claim.

sessions.label: 2 Taali practice
sessions.title: Rangili Ramzat 8 | 2 Taali Garba
sessions.rationale: The canonical continuous-set title explicitly says 2 Taali Garba and its source categories include be-taali. The prototype does not add synthetic chapter or practice-loop boundaries.

sessions.label: Festive dandiya
sessions.title: Maadi Tara Mandiriye | Nonstop Dandiya Mix
sessions.rationale: The canonical title says Nonstop Dandiya Mix and its categories include raas-dandiya. The word ‘festive’ remains an editorial hypothesis, not a popularity or measured-energy claim.

sessions.label: Devotional listening
sessions.title: Meldi Maa No Rankar | Nonstop Garba
sessions.rationale: The canonical continuous-set categories include devotional and traditional. Source duration is unknown, so the prototype deliberately shows no duration band.

studyPlan.participants: Include both novice and experienced Garba dancers/listeners; record experience level rather than assuming it.
tasks: Choose a session for a stated listening or dancing intent without opening Search.
Explain what you expect to happen after choosing a session.
Find direct Search or ordinary Nonstop browsing instead when none of the four sessions fits.
Identify whether duration and editorial labels are understandable and trustworthy.
record: Whether the listener chose confidently or hesitated.
Whether the chosen session matched their stated intent after they inspected the recording identity.
Whether editorial labels felt culturally accurate or misleading.
Whether four choices reduced effort or hid useful catalogue paths.

shipGate: Human cultural review of editorial intent labels is recorded.
Usability evidence from novice and experienced listeners is recorded.
A ship, revise or reject decision is documented.
Any production implementation reuses canonical Nonstop selection rather than duplicating recordings or provider logic.
